paper.title: Discrete Bi-Population Differential Evolution for Optimizing Complex Wind Farm Layouts in Diverse Terrains

paper_visible: WS5 has eight wind speeds and twelve uneven wind directions
WS6 has eight wind speeds and sixteen uneven wind directions
standard farm is 21 by 21 at 231 m
paper_figure_digitized: manual two-pass row-major transcription of numbered Fig.5 with 499 blocked and 285 available cells
source_cross_checked: NA_type=13 topology independently matches the manual Fig.5 transcription
declared_p3: WS5 twelve equally spaced angles and literal direction marginal
WS6 sixteen equally spaced angles and literal direction marginal
direction-speed independence and product joint probabilities
problem_authority_composition.spacing_boundary: The paper gives the Fig.5 topology and 250 m. The source independently matches the digitization but executes 231 m; this mixed authority remains a composite P3 problem, not an original-array reproduction.
problem_authority_composition.digitization_uncertainty: Each visible numbered cell was classified red/white manually in two passes. The exact match to the hash-frozen source topology is an independent cross-check, not redistribution of the no-license file.

method_freeze.physical_fes_rule: initial 50 plus at most 25 complete-layout evaluations per generation, stopping exactly at the requested total
method_freeze.fusion_rule: source-resolved half-sized floor rule: G-prime gets 12 superior and 13 inferior; B-prime gets 13 superior and 12 inferior
method_freeze.scale_rule: literal paper Eq.23 with Imax fixed at 400
method_freeze.crossover_rule: literal paper Eq.25 with Imax fixed at 400
method_freeze.method_identity_boundary: Distinct from bde_paper_equations_physical_fes_v1 because that implementation derived 398 as the schedule denominator.

execution_scheduling.evaluator: GranularityAware fused-state schedule with fixed reduction order
execution_scheduling.variation_repair: mutation, crossover, and repair are fused per offspring row
execution_scheduling.local_execution_rule: execute on the caller when logical_work is below 2048; otherwise use the persistent CPU executor
execution_scheduling.rejected_alternative: always dispatch two separate worker-team regions per generation for 25-row variation and repair
execution_scheduling.semantic_boundary: implementation scheduling only; RNG keys, random-event counts, transition order, exact FES, layouts, and objectives are invariant

hash_contract.runtime_objective_hash_rule: FNV-1a-64 over all evaluator constants, dimensions, spacing, turbine count, directions, speeds, and every joint probability
hash_contract.runtime_feasible_hash_rule: FNV-1a-64 over the full one-based grid availability vector, dimensions, spacing, and turbine count
hash_contract.manifest_case_hash_rule: SHA256 of each canonical case before its case_sha256 field is inserted

alternatives_rejected: reuse common FODE WS5/WS6, which are 13 speeds by 5/6 directions at 231 m
digitize Fig.4 and label plot estimates as exact author arrays
label the source's 231 m execution as the paper's 250 m experiment
inherit the old 398 schedule denominator under the old method semantic ID
pool or rank these P3 results with official-source WS1-WS4

factors: literal paper increasing scale schedule versus source decreasing schedule

claim_boundary: Development evidence for two distinct P3 composite problem identities only. Original WS5/WS6 arrays and paper results remain blocked; WS1-WS4 source replay is unchanged and incomparable.
